title: Tests: CAR export correctness and admin endpoint
description: Unit tests for car_writer.rs: verify CBOR header encoding, varint encoding correctness, block framing. Integration test in tests/car_export.rs: seed 3 articles via MemIpfsStore and articles table, call build_export_car(), parse the resulting CAR bytes, verify header has version=1, verify all 3 CIDs appear as blocks, verify each block's data matches what was written to the store.
